name: Berechiah
overview: Berechiah is identified in Scripture primarily as the father of the prophet Zechariah, emphasizing his role in the prophetic lineage of Israel during the time of Darius (Zechariah 1:1, 1:7). Additionally, Berechiah is mentioned as the son of Meshezabeel and appears in the context of the post-exilic community's efforts to rebuild Jerusalem, with his son Meshullam actively participating in the repair work (Nehemiah 3:4, 3:30). These references highlight Berechiah's familial connections within both prophetic and civic restoration activities, underscoring the faithful service of his descendants in God's redemptive plan.
